blocks.text: Noel Bazaar officially opened its doors on November 25, 2026 at the World Trade Center, marking the beginning of the much-anticipated holiday shopping destination. The six-day celebration offers a refreshed take on the nostalgic charm of Paskong Pinoy, complete with spectacular Christmas decorations, thoughtfully curated booths, and festive experiences for visitors of all ages. Transforming the lobby and outdoor spaces of World Trade Center with twinkling lights and colorful Christmas decorations that brought the warmth and familiarity of Paskong Pinoy to life were Ingarden Philippines Inc., and Angel’s Parol, whose creative contributions helped set the mood for the holiday celebrations even […]...
